description: The department of Electrical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Science offers a vibrant environment for postgraduate education and research in Electrical Engineering. Established in 1911, it is one of the first few departments at IISc. The vision of the department is to provide the leadership to enable India’s excellence in the field of Electrical Engineering. The department is committed to advancement of the frontiers of knowledge in Electrical Engineering and to provide the students with a stimulating and rewarding learning experience. ### Research interviews 2025. #### Awards and Recognition. * Awardees for Best Paper at the National Power Electronics Conference. * Awardees for Outstanding Teaching Assistant Award 2025. * Congratulations to Anupam Verma and his PhD mentor, Prof. Gopalaratnam Narayanan, for winning two Best Paper Awards in 2024! * Dr. Anwesha Mukhopadhyay received the attached Best Thesis award by the Industry Application Society of IEEE. # Research at EE. #### POWER ELECTRONICS.
